All 8 exchange for D in NaOD/D_{2}O through the enolate, so the answer is 8.

stem_marked: Which of the following give a yellow precipitate with I_{2}/NaOH? Mark all that apply.
answer_key: A, B, C, D, E, F
solution_steps: (A) ethanal: positive – contains CH_{3}CO– (methyl ketone / ethanal).
(B) ethanol: positive – is ethanol, the only primary alcohol that forms CH_{3}CHO.
(C) propan-2-ol: positive – contains CH_{3}CH(OH)– (oxidised in situ to CH_{3}CO–).
(D) butan-2-ol: positive – contains CH_{3}CH(OH)– (oxidised in situ to CH_{3}CO–).
(E) propanone: positive – contains CH_{3}CO– (methyl ketone / ethanal).
(F) butanone: positive – contains CH_{3}CO– (methyl ketone / ethanal).

review.note: Drawings checked against names: A ethanal, B ethanol, C propan-2-ol, D butan-2-ol, E propanone, F butanone. All six have CH3CO– or CH3CH(OH)– and give iodoform, so the key A,B,C,D,E,F is correct.
review.reviewer: AI reasoning check (not a second human reviewer)
